preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some MVK tokens to initiate the transfer
swapAndLiquifyEnabled must be true and contract must have accumulated enough tokens (exceeding minTokensBeforeSwap) to trigger swapAndLiquify
Attacker must not be blocked (checkUserBlocked[attacker] = false) and must satisfy sell eligibility requirements if selling to pancakePair

exploit_hint: Deploy a malicious contract with a fallback/receive function that re-enters the _transfer function while swapAndLiquify is executing. First, ensure the contract has accumulated tax fees (contractTokenBalance > minTokensBeforeSwap). Then trigger a transfer that causes swapAndLiquify to execute. During the external call to marketingwallet.transfer() or pancakeRouter.addLiquidityETH(), re-enter the _transfer function to manipulate state before balances are updated. This can potentially allow double-spending or bypass fee deductions.
